ORDER BY rnk

script:
WITH pts AS (
  SELECT latitude AS lat, longitude AS lon, mmsi, date, extract(hour FROM "timestamp") AS hr
  FROM read_parquet('s3://ais-noaa/broadcasts/*/ais-*.parquet')
  WHERE latitude BETWEEN 18.0 AND 23.5 AND longitude BETWEEN -161.5 AND -154.0
    AND vessel_type = 30
),
dist AS (
  SELECT *,
    LEAST(
      sqrt(power((lat-22.07)*60,2) + power((lon-(-159.50))*60*cos(radians(22.07)),2)),
      sqrt(power((lat-21.47)*60,2) + power((lon-(-157.98))*60*cos(radians(21.47)),2)),
      sqrt(power((lat-21.13)*60,2) + power((lon-(-157.02))*60*cos(radians(21.13)),2)),
      sqrt(power((lat-20.83)*60,2) + power((lon-(-156.92))*60*cos(radians(20.83)),2)),
      sqrt(power((lat-20.80)*60,2) + power((lon-(-156.33))*60*cos(radians(20.80)),2)),
      sqrt(power((lat-19.60)*60,2) + power((lon-(-155.50))*60*cos(radians(19.60)),2))
    ) AS nm
  FROM pts
),
banded AS (
  SELECT mmsi, date, hr,
    CASE WHEN nm<25 THEN '1_00-25nm' WHEN nm<50 THEN '2_25-50nm' WHEN nm<75 THEN '3_50-75nm'
         WHEN nm<100 THEN '4_75-100nm' WHEN nm<150 THEN '5_100-150nm' WHEN nm<300 THEN '6_150-300nm'
         ELSE '7_300nm+' END AS band
  FROM dist
)
SELECT band, count(*) AS raw_positions, count(DISTINCT (mmsi,date,hr)) AS vessel_hours, count(DISTINCT mmsi) AS vessels
FROM banded
GROUP BY band ORDER BY band

WITH pts AS (

  FROM read_parquet('s3://ais-noaa/broadcasts/*/ais-*.parquet')

dist AS (

    LEAST(
      sqrt(power((lat-22.07)*60,2) + power((lon-(-159.50))*60*cos(radians(22.07)),2)),
      sqrt(power((lat-21.47)*60,2) + power((lon-(-157.98))*60*cos(radians(21.47)),2)),
      sqrt(power((lat-21.13)*60,2) + power((lon-(-157.02))*60*cos(radians(21.13)),2)),

      sqrt(power((lat-20.80)*60,2) + power((lon-(-156.33))*60*cos(radians(20.80)),2)),
      sqrt(power((lat-19.60)*60,2) + power((lon-(-155.50))*60*cos(radians(19.60)),2))
    ) AS nm
  FROM pts
),
